title: 3.3 Direct Preference Optimization (DPO)
use_cases: Use when refining model outputs based on a static dataset of preferred and rejected responses
Implement when a simplified alternative to PPO is required to avoid training a separate reward model
Configure when aligning an action discriminator model with human preferences using direct loss optimization
Use when mapping optimal rewards directly to language model policies for faster convergence
